name: Glass
desc: Glass panels with a sheen, the way a desktop looked in 2009.
_note: Ported from the aero design mockup: glass panels, a gloss over the
top of everything, small radii, hairline edges. It keeps `list`, because
that era's shape IS a list of rows in a window -- the theme's work here is
all palette and motif, which is the case the token model has to handle as
well as it handles a structural change.
The mockup floats its windows over a dark green desk. Here the page itself
is pale, because the page is not a desk: with a dark background and pale
panels, one accent token cannot be read on both, and the pale page lets the
accent be the mockup's own dark grass green.
